name: cli-dashboard
description: Session panel under the prompt: context, limits, agents and tasks

softLimit.title: Soft limit (tokens)
softLimit.description: Context tokens the Dumb Meter treats as full. Leave unset for the per-model default.

theme.title: Theme
theme.description: Colour palette. pastel is recommended; rainbow is more saturated, mono uses one hue and hides the burn-rate colours, light suits light terminals, high-contrast maximises contrast.

icons.title: Icons
icons.description: nerd needs a Nerd Font; plain uses single-width Unicode symbols that any terminal draws.

animation.title: Animation
animation.description: full flows the gradient, cycles hues and spins; calm keeps only the spinner moving; off draws a static panel and stops the frame tick.

speed.title: Colour animation speed
speed.description: How fast the meter gradient and agent colours shift under full animation. The spinner keeps its pace.
